subject: Amendment Required to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against our Shipping Instruction, which serves as the authoritative reference.

We have found discrepancies that must be amended to ensure accuracy.

The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
